title: Generative AI & Transformer Architectures
description: Deep dive into self-attention heads, foundational LLMs, temperature sampling, and tokenization.

questions.question: Which mechanism enables Transformer models to compute relationships between all words in an input sequence simultaneously?
options: Self-Attention Mechanism
Recurrent Backpropagation
Linear Hash Indexing
Gradient Stacking

questions.question: What does 'temperature' control in generative language model sampling?
options: The physical temperature of the GPU hardware
The degree of randomness and creativity in generated responses
The maximum token count of the prompt context
The learning rate during model pre-training

questions.question: Which technique freezes base model weights and trains low-rank decomposition matrices for efficient fine-tuning?
options: LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation)
Zero-Shot Chain-of-Thought
Full Parameter SGD
Dynamic Quantization Layering

questions.question: What is 'Hallucination' in the context of Large Language Models?
options: When the model outputs plausible-sounding but factually inaccurate information
When the model exceeds its maximum allowed memory allocation
When an unauthorized user intercepts model prompt tokens
When the model runs out of inference compute cycles

questions.question: What is the primary role of Positional Encodings in Transformer models?
options: Informing the attention layers about the sequential order of input tokens
Compressing vocabulary embedding tables into lower dimensions
Preventing floating point underflow during Softmax normalization
Encrypting prompt tokens prior to neural processing
